_comment: Game rules content: stat labels, skills, levels and growth tiers. Every number a kid sees is calculated from their own activity in backend/src/progress/rules.ts.

stats.label: Energy
stats.note: Stays full when you learn every day

stats.label: Brain
stats.note: Grows with feed cards you get right

stats.label: Prompt power
stats.note: Grows when you win Prompt Battles

stats.label: Friendship
stats.note: Grows when Pip plays in Community

skills.name: Fake-fact detective
skills.description: Pip can spot when AI makes things up.
skills.hint: Get Feed cards right to level it up.

skills.name: How AI learns
skills.description: Pip knows AI learns patterns from examples.
skills.hint: Fix Pip’s blind spots in Train.

skills.name: Prompt crafter
skills.description: Pip writes clear asks with colors and details.

skills.name: Safety shield
skills.description: Pip never shares passwords or addresses.
skills.hint: Fix the privacy, voice-call and scam cards in Train.

skills.name: Fair judge
skills.description: Pip learns from balanced examples, not just one kind.
skills.hint: Fix more blind spots in Train.

tiers.name: Explorer
tiers.upgradeDescription: Reach Level 3 and Pip becomes an Explorer: arms, legs and an antenna.

tiers.name: Champ
tiers.upgradeDescription: Reach Level 6 and Pip becomes a Champ: muscles, a headband and a star badge.

tiers.name: Legend
tiers.upgradeDescription: Reach Level 10 and Pip becomes a Legend: a crown, a cape and a medal.
